sloka: भगवन्तः कुम्भकर्णं रावणं च निशाचरम् ।अतिक्रम्य महावीर्यौ किं प्रशंसथ रावणिम् ।। ७.१.३५ ॥
transliteration: bhagavantaḥ kumbhakarṇaṁ rāvaṇaṁ ca niśācaram ।atikramya mahāvīryau kiṁ praśaṁsatha rāvaṇim ।। 7.1.35 ॥

translations.english: This shloka lists several powerful demons: Mahodara, Prahasta, Virupaksha, Matta, Unmatta, Devantaka, and Narantaka, all of whom are formidable.
